why: The other half, and without it this family proved nothing about the answer it exists to give. Both of the verify cases here are failures, so a library reporting matched: false unconditionally passed all of them - demonstrated with a mutation by a third implementation, which is the same lesson 12.11 wrote down for the control plane's own gate: a gate that refuses everything is not evidence. Note what a match does not mean: the counters still split at the marker, the chunk below it is capped so a read never straddles it, and there is no `get` in the call list because nothing disagreed.
